title: Adverb or adjective
rule: An adjective describes a noun and agrees with it: una chica tranquila.
An adverb describes a verb, adjective or adverb and never changes: habla tranquilamente.
Adverbs in -mente are made from the feminine form: lenta → lentamente, fácil → fácilmente. Two in a row: only the last takes -mente (clara y lentamente).

questions: Describing how he sleeps: an adverb.
Habla ___, por favor; no te entiendo.
Describing how to speak: the adverb despacio.
Adverb from fácil, keeping its accent: fácilmente.
How she drives: the adverb bien.
A comment on the whole sentence: an adverb.
With two adverbs, only the last takes -mente.
Corre muy ___ para llegar a tiempo.
rápido can be an adverb too, and then it never changes.
When you get up: the adverb temprano.
Describing the adjective preparada: an adverb.
